_note: Colour rules for social cards (scripts/social-cards.cjs applies them at render time). Indigo stays the frame: logo, footer link, weekly signals. Each content pillar has an accent (a map colour from the site) and a cover style, so the Instagram grid and each feed alternate instead of repeating one indigo tile. cover: 'photo' = full-colour photo, 'paper' = light cover, 'colour' = the accent's own dark ground; none = indigo duotone. A platform can have its own dark ground. A card can override with its own accent, ground or cover ('none' switches one off).
